name: RC-B10-0471/2025 – After § 12 – Am 14
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text: 12b. Underlines that churches are vital providers of essential social services in Africa; calls on the Commission to involve these partners in the implementation of EU programmes; calls on the Commission and the European External Action Service in this context to promote dialogue with churches in partner countries;
